{{Top|leg}}
'''Frusoise''' was a language that had contributed words to the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] lexicon.

==Old Low Frusoise==
Old Low Frusoise was an archaic form of the language. Known words include:
*'''Debark''', ''verb'', meaning “to leave a small sailing ship's secondary boat.”

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wiktionary:debark|Debark]] has the same essential meaning as the English language word.
